dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Two thin, high-contrast white horizontal bands are visible; the lower band on the greater coverts is thicker and more prominent than the upper band on the median coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Highly prominent and sharp white edges on folded primary and secondary feathers provide clear boundaries against the dark feather centers.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white outer rectrices (tail feathers) contrast sharply with the dark central tail feathers.
